origin.description: Paste the arguments and wrap them in this ANSI style when colors are enabled.
origin.details: With cli.num_colors above 1, the open sequence is written, any copy of the close sequence inside the text is replaced by the open sequence, and the close sequence is written. With one color, the text is returned unchanged. A vector of codes is one escape sequence per code, because paste0 recycles.
